description: This source file defines structures and functions for retrieving and parsing socket statistics from /proc/net/sockstat and sockstat6, including IPv4 and IPv6 socket usage data, within the Prometheus procfs package.

methods.name: readSockstat
methods.description: Reads and parses socket statistics from a specified file path.

methods.name: parseSockstat
methods.description: Parses the contents of a sockstat file into a NetSockstat structure.

methods.name: parseSockstatKVs
methods.description: Converts key/value string slices into a map of integers.

methods.name: parseSockstatProtocol
methods.description: Creates a NetSockstatProtocol from a map of key/value pairs.
